main.description: A review of a media item, embedding the media's display metadata.

title.description: Title of the media item being reviewed.

facets.description: Rich-text facets (e.g. mentions, links) within the review text.

genres.description: Genres associated with the media item.

isRevisit.description: Whether this review is for a re-read/re-watch rather than a first experience.

mainCredit.description: Primary credited person for the media (e.g. book author, film director).

mainCreditRole.description: Role of the main credit (e.g. author, director, host).

creativeWorkType.description: Type of media: book, movie, tv, podcast, article, game, music, course, video, etc.

posterUrl.description: URL of the media item's poster/cover image.

backdropUrl.description: URL of the media item's backdrop image.

releaseDate.description: Release date of the media item.

notes.description: Private notes about the media item. Only visible to the owner. (Collective Social extension field, not part of the base popfeed schema.)

listItem.description: Optional reference (AT-URI) to the associated list item. (Collective Social extension field.)

mediaItemId.description: Reference to media_items table for aggregated data. (Collective Social extension field, not part of the base popfeed schema.)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this review was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this review was last updated.
